text_block_list.text:
Dia, I... I was totally clueless. About what
it means to run at Tracen
Academy, and
probably about everything else too.
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text: Kita...
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
I pictured myself training and growing
stronger... and winning lots of
glamorous
races! I fully believed I could do it if I just
worked hard
enough.
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
But I never imagined what that "hard work"
would actually look like,
or how much of it
I'd need to put in if I really wanted to win.
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Teio overcomes all those challenges and
keeps on running. That's
what makes her
so strong and incredible.
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text: Yeah... You're right.
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
To become someone like her... Do I really
have what it takes to push
myself that far?
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Do I really have what it takes to put a
smile on people's faces?
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
I know what you mean—it's a scary thing.
We just learned how tough
the racing
world really is, after all.
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text: You feel the same?
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
I thought I had the necessary resolve, but I
was just being naive.
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
Still, you know what? I think we're going
to be just fine!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text: Because I'm right beside you, Kita!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Do you remember what Nature told us
before? The thing you need to
become a
shining star...
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sorry. Yeah—I'm talking about the
protagonists of the
academy. You'll see
Teio and McQueen aren't the only shining
stars
here.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Everyone here has dreams and the raw
skills to see them through. It's
a hearty
full-course feast of protagonists, each with
their own rivals!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Dreams, skills... and rivals.
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Kita, you're a very precious friend to me...
but you're just as precious
to me as a rival!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
Remember when we first met? That day,
you had come to help with
some volunteer
work.
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
You were the first Umamusume my age I
had ever talked to, so I was
really nervous.
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
And I was surprised that there was
someone out there faster than me!
It really
opened my eyes!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
After that, you took me to lots of new
places. You taught me so many
things, like
how to play the games at the candy shop
and how to take
a tumble.
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
You led the way as we ran together,
opening my eyes to the vastness
of the
world around us. Staring at your back in
front of me, I came to
realize something.
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
I wanted to surpass you—to take the lead
myself.
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text: Dia...
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
For as long as I've known you, you've
always loved helping people.
Maybe you
were just showing me the same kindness.
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
But it was different for me. I've always
seen you as a rival.
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
It's true that the other students here are
incredible. No matter how
hard we work,
we may never catch up to them. But even
so...
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
As long as you're running ahead of me, I
won't stop trying to overtake
you. I'll keep
improving until I can.
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
So let's keep running together, Kita. From
now until forever!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text: Cross my heart and hope to die. Together forever, you and I!
text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan and Satono

text_block_list.text:
(That's right. From the first time I met Dia,
I knew she was different
from my other
friends.)
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to win a G1 race and make
everyone's dream come true!
text_block_list.name: Young Satono

text_block_list.text:
(She was naive and a little detached, but
she never cried when she
fell. And she was
always upfront and honest to me about her
dreams.)
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
(No matter how hard I tried to sprint
ahead, she always stuck close
behind.
Eventually, we wound up running side by
side.)
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
(It was frustrating... and it made me want
to get better.)
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Dia. I guess I let my worries get
the better of me.
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
But having a rival to push you in the right
direction... That's such an
inspiring
thought!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text: Kita...
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
I may not know everything about dreams
or what it means to run—or
even my own
potential. But still...
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text: I have a rival to run alongside me.
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
That's why no matter how tough things
get, I'll be okay. I can smile
and overcome
any obstacle with you by my side, Dia!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I should warn you—I won't let you
catch up to me during
races! So you'd
better be ready!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
...!
Same here! I don't plan on losing!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
Someday, I'm gonna become a stronger
version of myself and achieve
my dreams...
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Because I've decided to chase them with
you!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк
